# [Launched] Generally Available: Files knowledge source for Foundry IQ

## What Changed

Upload files directly to a managed knowledge source in Foundry IQ. Foundry IQ processes and indexes the files for retrieval through a knowledge base, so you don't need to provision a storage account or scheduled indexer.Learn more.

## Why It Matters to a CSA

A generally available capability may remove a blocker or create an expansion opportunity.
